parsed.rationale: Contrary to the suggestion that this ECG is normal, the lead II rhythm strip is irregularly irregular (RR intervals vary from about 0.52 to 0.79 s) with no clear P waves and a fine fibrillatory baseline; the only ST changes are scooped ST depressions in I, II and V4-V6, with no ST elevation meeting STEMI criteria.
